report.explanation: Current telemetry is internally contradictory: gateway traces show an ERROR call to order (1995ms) while gateway metrics/logs show error_rate 0.001, p95 76ms and status 200; order checkout trace is OK. Order shows elevated retained memory (260MB) with retained_after_gc and WARN logs, but no chronological retention series, so a leak is not established. Deployment record alone cannot establish latency causation. Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Order service memory-retention time series to distinguish a leak trend from a single elevated reading
Gateway trace error detail (status code, error message) to explain the ERROR span against healthy gateway metrics
Order checkout span breakdown to locate the 1050ms latency source
Postgres/redis dependency latency metrics for order's downstreams
